comparison.objective: Replace a wiper blade while supporting the arm and lowering it gently onto glass.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual arm support, hooked-part removal, aligned insertion, click latching, and controlled lowering.
comparison.success_condition: Old blade is discarded, new blade clicks in, and arm is lowered without snapping down; numeric force and position limits are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests replacement and snap-latching while protecting glass, not commissioning an adjustable shock absorber.
